propositions: CLI write-command argument parsing currently uses hand-rolled loops with bespoke semantics that are not reflected in schema or --help output.
The --assignee flag has sentinel semantics where absent means None (triggering default_assignee fallback) and explicit empty string clears the assignee, which must be preserved.
The --force flag must remain a bare boolean that bypasses the gate, with the audit note supplied via separate --reason flag (no inline --force=<reason> form).
The refactor must preserve all exit codes, flag spellings, and behavioral contracts relative to the post-blusterous CLI surface.
Hand-rolled parsing in _parse_force, _parse_assignee, and _parse_flags must be replaced with stdlib argparse while maintaining module-size and per-function complexity constraints.
